'''2026 Retro Worlds Jeremy Christoffel LS Echo Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jeremy Christoffel]] at the [[2026 Retro World Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jeremy Christoffel]]
* '''Event:''' [[2026 Retro World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:26RWC Christoffel LS Echo Base Operations.txt |Download]]
